quote.text: It’s silly to try to escape other people’s faults. They are inescapable. Just try to escape your own.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that all individuals, including our children, will make mistakes. Instead of focusing on their faults, guide them by refining your own character and behavior.
    • Embrace the idea that growth begins from within; cultivate patience and self-awareness to serve as a role model, knowing that self-improvement is a continuous journey.
  • Leadership:
    • Accept that flaws are an inherent part of human nature. Rather than trying to extinguish mistakes in others, lead by example and strive to overcome your own shortcomings.
    • This focus on self-improvement not only elevates your leadership but also inspires your team to take responsibility for their actions and grow together in integrity.
  • Product Management:
    • In the realm of product management, the pursuit of perfection involves critically assessing your own assumptions and approaches, rather than blaming external challenges or team errors.
    • By fostering a mindset of continuous self-evaluation and adaptation, you encourage innovation and resilience, allowing you and your team to navigate pitfalls and ultimately create superior products.
